title: DNS Leak Endpoint Diversity by Network
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dnsleak:check
| stats dc(resolver_ip) as resolver_count count as checks by network_name
| sort 0 - resolver_count
description: Ranks networkss by DNS leak endpoint diversity.
value: Unexpected resolver diversity can show that one network is ignoring VPN assumptions or switching paths unpredictably.
implementation: Send DNS leak endpoint diversity events to `index=personal` and keep `network_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of DNS leak endpoint diversity by networks.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which networkss stand out most for DNS leak endpoint diversity.
